user.title: General settings
user.description: Configure Streaming Top FR. Advanced settings can later be changed from **Settings → Devices & services → Streaming Top FR → Configure**.

data_description.update_hours: Interval between automatic updates, from 2 to 24 hours.

services.title: Streaming services
services.description: Enable only the subscriptions you want to use. Rental and purchase offers are ignored.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.description: Configure carousel size and reserve depth.

top_catalog.title: Top Streaming / IMDb
top_catalog.description: JustWatch France defines the local candidate pool; IMDb then ranks quality inside that pool.

decades.title: Decades
decades.description: Choose the default decade and the decades available in Top Streaming. The default decade is automatically kept enabled.

family.title: Family mode
family.description: Configure the Family branch of Top Streaming.

classification.title: Age ratings
classification.description: French ratings have priority. US fallback is used only when no usable French rating is available.

playback.title: Android TV / Freebox playback
playback.description: Automated playback is optional. It requires Home Assistant entities for remote control and Android Debug Bridge.

player.title: Playback destination
player.description: Select the Home Assistant entities for your Android TV / Freebox Pop.

error.player_already_exists: A destination already uses this ID.

players.title: Playback destinations
players.description: Add a destination or select an existing destination to edit it.

summary.title: Settings summary

default_decade.title: Default decade
default_decade.description: Choose the decade shown automatically when the Top Streaming card opens. It will remain enabled.

error.player_already_exists: A destination already uses this ID.
